title.narrative: General Volunteer Project for Knowledge Enrichment and Transfer (Financial Reporting Preparation)

description.narrative: Enhancing knowledge and community participation through training on financial reporting preparation. The project focuses on training local cadres in financial and accounting skills, contributing to strengthening transparency and accountability within institutions.

Strengthen financial knowledge: provide training on financial reporting and accounting preparation. Improve transparency: increase the level of transparency in institutions through accurate and reliable financial reports. Strengthen personal skills: develop the administrative and financial skills of local cadres, helping them in their professional lives. Facilitate knowledge transfer: establish a platform for sharing financial knowledge and expertise.
